Best open-ear earbuds for running (2026)

Based only on the search results you provided, my top recommendation is the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 for dedicated running, especially outdoors. If you want better everyday music quality and a clip-on design, consider the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds instead.

Top 5 picks
Best for running

1. Shokz OpenRun Pro 2

$125 at REI or Best Buy

Combines bone and air conduction for fuller sound while leaving your ears open to traffic. WIRED rated it 8/10 and praised its running fit, sound, and improved battery.

Best for: Road runners who prioritize awareness and a secure workout fit.

Best overall

2. Bose Ultra Open Earbuds

$199

Runner's World names these its best overall open-ear headphones. The clip-on design, excellent audio quality, comfortable fit, and easy controls make them versatile for runs and everyday use.

Best for: Runners who want premium sound in a convenient clip-on format.

Best value with discount

3. Soundcore AeroFit 2

$104 with code AFSC20

Adjustable ear hooks, IP55 protection, multipoint Bluetooth, LDAC support, and up to 42 hours of battery life with the case. A strong option for runners and cyclists who want to hear their surroundings.

Best for: Everyday training, long battery life, and value.

A quick safety and fit note

Open-ear headphones help you hear traffic and other people, but they don't guarantee safety. Keep the volume low enough to hear your surroundings. For running in rain or sweat, check the water-resistance rating: the AeroFit 2 and OpenRun Pro 2 are IP55-rated, while the OpenDots 2 are IP57-rated, according to the supplied results.

My final pick: I'd choose the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 for regular outdoor running. If you prefer conventional speaker-style audio and don't want a neckband, go with the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds.
